blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A conventional embodied agent in an indoor environment builds a map by accumulating noisy real-world measurements and results from heavy inference to guide navigation. While the detailed measurements may differ due to scene changes or sensor settings, the unique topological structure of navigable passages or the connectivity between rooms may provide training-free guidance that complements local observations. We propose a sparse topometric graph as an efficient structural representation for robust indoor navigation, alleviating the need for fine-grained matching, which is computationally expensive, memory-intensive, and prone to real-world variations. The map consists of nodes that encode local 3D geometry and distance-weighted edges that capture traversable connectivity. A learned graph-matching network finds consistent subgraph structures across sessions by considering both node-level geometric descriptors and neighborhood connectivity. The holistic contextual matching is robust to local ambiguities caused by weak distinctiveness or repetitive structure, and establishes stable correspondences despite local scene changes, different sensor modalities, or limited spatial overlap. We analyze the practicality of the graph through cross-session point-goal navigation, where a goal specified in a prior reference map must be reached from an unknown initial pose in a later session. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest success rates (77.1% on Gibson and 40.0% under 3D-FRONT scene changes), while reducing memory by more than two orders of magnitude compared to point-level representations. The proposed approach further supports cross-session alignment and goal-directed navigation with strong scalability and robust real-world transfer.
blocks.zh: 室内环境中的常规内含剂通过积累吵闹的现实世界测量结果和从沉重的推论中得出指导导航的结果来绘制地图. 虽然详细测量可能因场景变化或传感器设置而有所不同,但可导航通道的独特地形结构或房间之间的连接可能提供无培训指导,补充局部观测. 我们提出一个稀疏的透析图,作为强大的室内导航的高效结构代表,缓解了精细配比的需求,这种配比在计算上昂贵,内存密集,容易发生现实世界的变化. 地图包括将本地3D几何编码的节点和捕捉可逆连接的远程加权边. 一个学习到的图形比对网络通过考虑节点级几何描述符和邻里连接,在整个会话中发现了一致的子图结构. 整体上下文匹配与因差异性弱或重复性结构造成的局部模糊性很强,尽管局部场景变化,传感器模式不同,或者空间重叠程度有限,但仍建立了稳定的对应关系. 我们通过跨会场点-目标导航来分析该图的实用性,即先前参考地图中规定的目标必须在以后一届会议上从未知的初始位置上达到。 实验显示,我们的方法取得了最高的成功率(在Gibson上为77.1%,在3D-FRONT场景变化下为40.0%),同时与点级表示相比,将内存减少了两个以上的数量级. 拟议方法进一步支持跨会场对齐和瞄准导航,具有强大的可伸缩性和强大的现实世界转移.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Real-world office scene with repetitive structure captured weeks apart with heterogeneous sensors. 3D scans with limited overlap are independently collected using a handheld LiDAR scanner and a mobile phone, respectively, and related via the proposed sparse topometric graphs.
For a selected query node, geometry-only candidates shown in green and appearance-only candidates from DINOv2 features [ 19 ] remain highly ambiguous. Graph-structured matching resolves this ambiguity and identifies the correct correspondence.
blocks.zh:
图1:具有重复结构的现实世界办公场景与不同的传感器相隔数周。 具有有限重叠的3D扫描器分别使用手持的LiDAR扫描仪和手机独立采集,并通过拟议的稀疏透析图进行关联.
对于一个选定的查询节点,仅以绿色和只以外观显示的来自DINOv2特征的几何候选人[19]仍然非常模糊. 图形结构匹配可以解决这一模糊性,并识别正确的对应.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Embodied agents in daily life need to understand spatial context to interact in unstructured environments.
Capturing the spatial map of the deployed environment often requires composing multiple measurements with minimal overlap, as indoor scenes often contain complex concavities, frequent occlusions, and confined navigable spaces due to furniture, rooms, and narrow passages with corners.
Reusing the acquired map in a separate session poses additional difficulties.
Transferring the high-quality geometry of the entire deployed space may require extensive spatial memory, and reusing the map with a different embodiment may encounter scene changes and different sensor configurations with unknown relative poses.
blocks.zh:
日常生活中的健美剂需要理解空间背景,以便在无结构的环境中相互作用.
捕捉所部署环境的空间图往往需要编组多重测量,最小的重叠,因为室内场景往往包含复杂的凝聚,频繁的隐蔽,以及由于家具,房间,以及带有角的狭窄通道而限制的可航行空间.
在单独的会话中重用所获得的地图会造成更多的困难.
传输整个部署空间的高质量几何可能要求广泛的空间内存,用不同的浮雕重新使用地图可能会遇到场景变化和不同的传感器配置,其相对姿势不明.

blocks.en:
Prior navigation studies [ 6 , 21 , 25 , 7 ] have used different spatial representations for mapping, localization, and planning in 2D top-down maps of large-scale indoor environments.
Dense metric maps [ 6 , 21 , 12 , 7 ] preserve detailed geometry and support path planning, but their storage and matching costs rapidly increase with environment scale.
Keyframe- [ 5 , 23 , 4 ] and appearance-based [ 2 , 14 , 15 , 25 ] maps are compact and visually informative, but their reliability can degrade under viewpoint and scene changes.
Semantic and hierarchical scene graphs [ 11 , 13 , 32 , 36 ] provide higher-level structure through layouts, objects, or language descriptions, but often depend on reliable detections, explicit labels, or predefined semantic categories.
blocks.zh:
先前的导航研究[6, 21, 25, 7]在大型室内环境的2D自上而下地图中使用了不同的空间表示法来进行测绘,本地化和规划.
密集的公尺地图[6, 21, 12, 7] 保存详细的几何学和支持路径规划,但其存储和匹配成本随环境尺度迅速增加.
关键框架-[5、23、4]和基于外观的[2、14、15、25]地图是紧凑的,具有视觉信息,但其可靠性可在视角和场景变化下下降。
语义和等级的场景图[11,13,32,36]通过布局,对象,或语言描述提供更高层次的结构,但往往依赖于可靠的检测,明确的标签,或预定义的语义分类.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a sparse topometric graph that can reliably capture geometric context despite prevalent ambiguities in indoor environments with repetitive structures, moved furniture, and heterogeneous sensor modalities.
In the presence of such variations, local features are insufficient to extract reliable geometric context, and a broader spatial arrangement must be considered.
Our proposed graph representation summarizes the spatial organization of traversable space. Each node is centered on traversable structure rather than on a sampled point in the cloud, aggregates the observed 3D points within a fixed-radius neighborhood, and stores a compact geometry-only descriptor, while each edge represents free-space connectivity with a distance-based weight.
This fixed-radius aggregation makes local geometry reusable at the graph level instead of tying descriptors to raw point samples [ 20 , 28 ] .
Compressing each local point set into a fixed-size node descriptor keeps the map size proportional to the number of graph nodes rather than the raw scene geometry, while preserving enough local and structural information for cross-session map reuse.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出了一个稀疏的几何图形,可以可靠地捕捉几何背景,尽管室内环境中普遍存在结构重复、家具移动和各种传感器模式模糊不清的情况。
在存在这种变化的情况下,局部特征不足以得出可靠的几何背景,必须考虑更广泛的空间安排。
我们提议的图示概括了可移动空间的空间组织。 每个节点都以可变结构为中心,而不是以云中一个取样点为中心,在固定辐射区内汇总观测到的3D点,并存储一个紧凑的几何独有的描述符,而每个边缘则代表自由空间的连通性,具有基于距离的重量.
这种固定射线聚合使得局部几何在图级可以重复使用,而不是将描述符与原始点样本[20,28]绑定.
将每个本地点压缩成一个固定大小的节点描述符,保持地图大小与图形节点数成比例,而不是原始场景几何,同时保留足够的局部和结构信息供跨会场地图再利用.

blocks.en:
We demonstrate the usability of the representation in cross-session point-goal navigation .
The agent starts from an unknown initial pose and must reach the goal pose, defined on the reference map built in a previous session.
The agent first aligns its current observations relative to the reference map and selects waypoints toward the goal while taking the navigable path topology into account.
We train a graph-matching network to predict cross-session correspondences between graph nodes by jointly considering local geometry and connectivity between neighboring nodes.
The predicted correspondences are used to estimate the relative transformation between the reference and current sessions, after which the graph-based navigation policy guides the agent toward the transferred goal.
This setting lets us study whether a single sparse representation can support both cross-session alignment and downstream navigation.
blocks.zh:
我们显示了跨会点-目标导航的代表性的可用性。
代理从未知的初始姿势开始,必须达到目标姿势,在前一个会话中构建的参考地图上定义.
该代理首先将当前观测结果与参考地图相对应,并在考虑可导航路径地形的同时,选择向目标前进的道路。
我们训练一个图比网络,通过共同考虑本地几何和邻近的节点之间的连通性来预测图表节点之间的交叉会话通信.
预测的函证用于估计参考和当前会议之间的相对变化,之后,基于图表的导航政策指导代理人向转移的目标迈进。
这一背景让我们研究,单一的稀疏代表是否能支持跨会场对接和下游航行。

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 illustrates our pipeline with a real-world cross-session example.
The example highlights a key challenge.
Local geometric descriptors or appearance-based cues can be ambiguous when similar structures repeat across partially overlapping sessions.
The proposed representation and graph matching reduce these ambiguities by considering both node-level geometry and neighboring graph connectivity.
blocks.zh:
图1以现实世界的跨会实例说明了我们的管道。
这个例子突出了一项关键的挑战。
当类似结构在部分重叠的会话中重复时,本地几何描述符或基于外观的提示可能模糊不清.
拟议的表示和图表匹配通过考虑节点级几何和相邻的图表连接性来减少这些模糊之处.

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose a sparse topometric graph for cross-session indoor map reuse. It represents traversable space with compact geometry-only node descriptors and distance-weighted graph connectivity, providing a scalable map representation. • We introduce a graph-node descriptor that aggregates fixed-radius 3D observations around reusable node centers. This makes local geometry available at the graph level instead of tying descriptors to individual point-cloud samples. • We introduce a learned graph-matching approach that predicts cross-session node correspondences using both local geometric similarity and graph connectivity, and we use the same graph for cross-session alignment and waypoint selection. • We evaluate the method on simulated cross-session navigation, large-scale indoor scenes, scene-change settings, and a real-world indoor study, demonstrating efficient and reliable cross-session map use.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出一个稀疏的孔径图,用于跨场室内地图的再利用。 它代表可变空间,带有紧凑的几何唯一节点描述符和远程加权图形连接,提供可缩放的地图表现. ^ 我们引入一个图节点描述符,将可重复使用的节点中心周围的固定辐射3D观测集合起来. 这使得本地几何在图级上可以使用,而不是将描述符与单个点-云样绑在一起。 我们采用了一种学习到的图表比对方法,利用本地几何相似度和图表连通性来预测跨会场节点对应,我们使用相同的图表来进行跨会场对齐和路标选择. ^ 我们评价模拟跨会场导航、大规模室内场景、场景变化设置以及现实世界室内研究的方法,展示高效和可靠的跨会场地图使用情况。

blocks.en: We propose a sparse topometric graph for cross-session indoor map reuse. It represents traversable space with compact geometry-only node descriptors and distance-weighted graph connectivity, providing a scalable map representation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个稀疏的孔径图,用于跨场室内地图的再利用。 它代表可变空间,带有紧凑的几何唯一节点描述符和远程加权图连接,提供可缩放的地图表现.

blocks.en: We introduce a graph-node descriptor that aggregates fixed-radius 3D observations around reusable node centers. This makes local geometry available at the graph level instead of tying descriptors to individual point-cloud samples.
blocks.zh: 我们引入一个图节点描述符,将可重复使用的节点中心周围的固定辐射3D观测集合起来. 这使得本地几何可以在图级上提供,而不是将描述符绑在单个点-云标上.

blocks.en: We introduce a learned graph-matching approach that predicts cross-session node correspondences using both local geometric similarity and graph connectivity, and we use the same graph for cross-session alignment and waypoint selection.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个学习到的图比方法,利用本地几何相似度和图比连通性来预测跨会话节点对应,我们使用相同的图来进行跨会话对齐和路标选择.

blocks.en: We evaluate the method on simulated cross-session navigation, large-scale indoor scenes, scene-change settings, and a real-world indoor study, demonstrating efficient and reliable cross-session map use.
blocks.zh: 我们评价模拟跨会场导航、大规模室内场景、场景变化设置以及现实世界室内研究的方法,展示高效和可靠的跨会场地图使用情况。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the proposed cross-session localization and navigation framework. Given depth D t D_{t} and odometry O t O_{t} inputs, the agent constructs a topometric graph using medial-axis decomposition and assigns geometric descriptors from local point clouds. Node correspondences M M are estimated across reference graph 𝒢 ref \mathcal{G}^{\text{ref}} and current graph 𝒢 cur \mathcal{G}^{\text{cur}} via graph matching. The correspondences are reused for both localization and navigation. The navigation policy combines the goal-directed score S goal S_{\text{goal}} with the frontier-based exploration score S explore S_{\text{explore}} to select a node as the next waypoint toward the goal position g g of the cross-session navigation task.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Map Representations for Navigation
blocks.zh: 2.1 导航地图

blocks.en:
Metric maps , such as occupancy grids and voxel maps [ 21 , 12 ] , provide fine-grained geometric detail for obstacle avoidance and motion planning.
However, their reliance on globally consistent poses makes them vulnerable to accumulated drift and scene changes across sessions, often leading to degraded map quality [ 27 ] . Appearance-based methods [ 15 , 31 ] represent scenes via stored images or learned visual features, enabling viewpoint-aware matching and memory-efficient planning.
Visual place recognition (VPR) approaches [ 14 ] extend this to cross-session localization by matching compact global descriptors between sessions.
They are more robust to spatial drift but remain sensitive to lighting, occlusion, and viewpoint deviation. Object-centric scene graphs [ 11 , 13 , 17 , 10 ] offer higher-level reasoning by representing objects and their relations, supporting semantically meaningful planning.
In particular, ObjReact [ 10 ] targets cross-session navigation by constructing an object-centric 3D scene graph and reactively planning routes toward recognized goal-relevant objects.
However, these approaches rely on consistent object detection and semantic stability across time.
To support a fair and diverse evaluation, we adopt representative methods from each of the above categories as baselines for cross-session navigation: a metric-based grid map [ 6 ] , appearance-based maps [ 15 , 14 ] , and object-centric scene graphs [ 11 , 10 ] .
blocks.zh:
测量图,如占用网格图和Voxel图[21,12],提供了精细的几何细节,用于避障和运动规划.
然而,它们对全球一致性的依赖使它们容易受到累积漂流和不同会议场景变化的影响,往往导致地图质量下降[27]。 基于外观的方法[15,31]通过存储的图像或学习到的视觉特征来代表场景,能够使视角意识匹配和内存高效的规划.
视觉位置识别(VPR)方法[14]通过在会间匹配紧凑的全球描述符,将它扩展到跨会场本地化.
它们比空间漂移更强,但对照明、闭塞和视差仍然敏感。 以物体为中心的场景图[11,13,17,10]通过代表物体及其关系,支持有目的的规划,提供了更高层次的推理.
特别是,ObjReact [10]通过构建以物体为中心的3D场景图和被动规划路线,瞄准与目标相关的公认物体,从而实现跨会场导航.
然而,这些方法依赖于始终如一的物体探测和语义稳定性。
为了支持公平和多样的评价,我们采用了上述每一类的代表性方法,作为跨会话导航的基线:一个基于公制的网格图[6],基于外观的图[15,14],以及以物体为中心的场景图[11,10].

blocks.en:
Beyond these, point-level geometric descriptors [ 20 , 28 ] enable fine-grained spatial alignment and have demonstrated strong performance in localization and map registration tasks.
Rather than using them densely, we adopt their desirable geometric properties in a compact, node-anchored form, combining their discriminative power with structural abstraction for scalable cross-session navigation.
blocks.zh:
除此之外,点级几何描述符[20,28]能够实现精细的空间对齐,并在本地化和地图注册任务中表现出了强大的性能.
与其密集地使用它们,不如以紧凑的,节点式的形式采用它们理想的几何属性,将它们的歧视性力量与结构抽象结合起来,用于可伸缩的跨会话导航.

blocks.en:
Our work bridges these extremes by introducing a sparse topometric graph that generates a topological graph over navigable areas, where each graph node is anchored with sparse 3D geometric descriptors.
This structure supports both cross-session localization and goal-directed planning in a single pipeline, offering a compact and robust map representation for cross-session navigation.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作通过引入一个稀疏的拓扑图来弥合这些极端,该图在可航行地区上产生一个地形图,每个图节点都用稀疏的三维几何描述符固定在那里。
这一结构既支持跨会场本地化,又支持在单一的管道中进行目标导向规划,为跨会场导航提供紧凑而有力的地图代表。

blocks.en: 2.2 Graph-based Correspondence
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于图表的信件

blocks.en:
Graph-based representations encode spatial relationships that support structural reasoning for localization and navigation.
Factor graphs have long provided the backbone for multi-session SLAM [ 8 ] , while learned approaches construct topological maps where nodes represent visited locations and edges encode navigability [ 7 , 25 ] .
Recent work studies cross-session localization and graph-based alignment over object- or scene-level abstractions, with node-level features drawn from different modalities and semantics [ 18 , 24 , 35 ] .
These approaches demonstrate that reasoning about relational structure helps resolve ambiguities that local features alone cannot resolve.
blocks.zh:
基于图形的表示法编码了空间关系,支持本地化和导航的结构推理.
要素图长期以来为多段SLAM[8]提供了支柱,而学到的方法则构建了地形图,其中节点代表被访问地点和边缘的通航性[7,25].
近期的工作研究对对象或场景级抽象进行跨会话定位和图表对齐,从不同模式和语义中抽取节点级特征[18,24,35].
这些方法表明,对关系结构的推理有助于解决地方特征本身无法解决的模糊问题。

blocks.en:
However, object-level graphs rely on stable semantic detection, which degrades under scene changes or sensing heterogeneity.
Related work has also explored learned geometric descriptors and registration over point-cloud features [ 20 , 28 ] .
Such methods typically operate at the point or object level rather than over navigable spatial regions.
blocks.zh:
然而,物体级图依赖于稳定的语义检测,在场景变化或感知异质性下可降解.
相关工作还探索了在点云特征上学习到的几何描述和注册[20,28].
这种方法一般在点或物体一级运作,而不是在可航行的空间区域。

blocks.en:
Our graph provides a sparse topological description of traversable regions that compactly encodes reachability from the agent’s current position.
The graph structure also enables holistic cross-session matching of connected regions, which is robust to perturbations in local features and to moderate topological deviations arising from scene changes or measurement discrepancies.
blocks.zh:
我们的图表对可移动区域提供了稀疏的地形描述,这些区域从代理商目前的位置对可到达性作了紧凑的编码。
图表结构还使连接区域能够进行整体的跨会场匹配,这对局部特征的扰动和场景变化或测量差异产生的中度地形偏差十分有力.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Cross-session navigation with a sparse topometric graph
blocks.zh: 算法 1 用稀疏的直径图进行跨会话导航

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We introduce a sparse topometric graph representation and a pipeline for cross-session localization and navigation.
We consider a cross-session navigation task in which an agent operates in an indoor environment for which a reference map was constructed in a prior session.
The reference session is represented as a sparse topometric graph 𝒢 ref \mathcal{G}^{\text{ref}} .
At deployment, the agent is at an unknown pose within the same environment and must navigate to a goal position g ∈ ℝ 2 g\in\mathbb{R}^{2} specified in the coordinate frame of the reference session.
The current session may differ from the reference due to trajectory variation, partial spatial overlap, accumulated odometry drift, and local scene arrangement.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了稀疏的图示和跨会场定位和导航管道。
我们认为一项跨会场的导航任务,即物剂在室内环境中运作,在前一届会议上绘制了参考地图。
参考会话以稀疏的图G ref\mathcal{G}^{\text{ref}}}表示.
部署时,代理在同一个环境中处于未知的姿势,必须导航到参考会话坐标框中指定的目标位置 g QQ R 2 g\in\ mathb{R}^{2}.
由于轨迹变化、部分空间重叠、累积的偏振漂移以及局部场景安排,本届会议可能与参考不同。

blocks.en:
An overview of the proposed approach is shown in Fig. 2 , and Alg. 1 summarizes the deployment loop.
At each time step t t , the agent receives a depth observation D t D_{t} and an odometry measurement O t = ( x t , y t , θ t ) O_{t}=(x_{t},y_{t},\theta_{t}) in its local frame.
Using the stream { ( D τ , O τ ) } τ = 1 t \{(D_{\tau},O_{\tau})\}_{\tau=1}^{t} , the agent incrementally constructs a top-down occupancy map 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} and a depth-derived accumulated point cloud 𝒫 t \mathcal{P}_{t} .
Every K = 20 K{=}20 steps, these geometric observations are converted into a current-session graph 𝒢 t cur \mathcal{G}^{\text{cur}}_{t} . ( BuildGraph , Sec. 3.1 ).
To enable cross-session localization, the agent performs topometric graph matching between 𝒢 t cur \mathcal{G}^{\text{cur}}_{t} and 𝒢 ref \mathcal{G}^{\text{ref}} , producing candidate node correspondences ℳ \mathcal{M} ( FindCorr , Sec. 3.2 ).
These correspondences are then used for relative pose estimation and navigation toward the reference-session goal, without relying on dense map alignment or continuous pose tracking across sessions ( NavScore , Sec. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Sparse Topometric Graph
blocks.zh: 3.1 平方图

blocks.en:
The BuildGraph stage in Alg. 1 (lines 4 – 8 ) constructs the shared representation used by the rest of the pipeline.
We represent each session as a topometric graph 𝒢 = ( 𝒱 , ℰ ) \mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E}) .
Here, topometric denotes the joint encoding of topological connectivity among navigable anchors and metric and geometric information.
Each node v i ∈ 𝒱 v_{i}\in\mathcal{V} corresponds to a navigable anchor extracted from traversable free space and is associated during graph construction with a 2D position 𝐩 i ∈ ℝ 2 \mathbf{p}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{2} and a sparse 3D geometric descriptor f i ∈ ℝ 32 f_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{32} .
Edges ℰ \mathcal{E} encode traversable connectivity between adjacent nodes, where each edge weight stores the local distance d i ​ j = ∥ 𝐩 i − 𝐩 j ∥ 2 d_{ij}=\lVert\mathbf{p}_{i}-\mathbf{p}_{j}\rVert_{2} between neighboring anchors.
blocks.zh:
阿尔格1的BuildGraph阶段(第4至第8行)构建了管道其余部分使用的共享代表.
我们作为缩略图 G = (V, E)\ mathcal{G}=(\mathcal{V},\mathcal{E})代表每个会话。
这里,拓扑表示可航行锚地之间地形连接的联合编码以及度量和几何信息.
每个节点 v i ∈ V v_{i}\in\ mathcal{V} 对应一个从可移动自由空间中提取的可导航锚,并在图形构造中与 2D 位置关联 p i QQR 2\ mathbf{p}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{2} 和 稀疏的 3D 几何描述符 fi ∈ R 32 f_{i}\i}\in\mathbb{R}^{32}.
边缘 E\ mathcal{E} 编码相邻节点之间的可互联互通, 每个节点的边重存储本地距离 di j = ∥ pi - p j ∥ 2 d_{ d_{j}=\lVert\ mathbf{p}_{i} -\ mathbf{p}_{j}\rVert_{2} 在相邻锚点之间.

blocks.en:
The graph is derived from two complementary geometric representations.
A top-down occupancy map is used to identify reachable traversable free space and extract graph nodes, while a depth-derived accumulated point cloud is used to compute geometric descriptors within each node.
We first extract the portion of free space that is reachable from the agent’s current position so that the graph remains focused on reusable navigable structure rather than on every nominally free cell in the dense map.
Navigable anchors are defined by the structure of the reachable free-space occupancy map, with graph nodes placed at uniform intervals of d = 5 d{=}5 cells ( 0.25 0.25 m) along each branch.
The nodes anchor local traversable areas from which features are extracted.
blocks.zh:
该图来源于两个互补的几何表示法.
使用自上而下的占用图来识别可伸展的自由空间并提取图表节点,同时使用深源累积点云计算每个节点内的几何描述符.
我们首先从代理商的当前位置中提取可以到达的自由空间部分,这样图仍然侧重于可再使用的可导航结构,而不是密集图中每个名义上的自由单元格.
可通航锚按可通航的自由空间占用图的结构来定义,图节点沿每个分支放置在统一间隔为d=5 d{=}5细胞(0.25 0.25 m).
节点锚定局部可移动区域,从中提取特征.

blocks.en:
The key geometric design choice is how node descriptors are defined.
Unlike the original per-point formulation, descriptors are anchored at navigable graph nodes rather than at existing points in the cloud.
For each node v i v_{i} , we collect points { q ∈ 𝒫 : ‖ q − 𝐩 i ‖ < r } \{q\in\mathcal{P}:\|q-\mathbf{p}_{i}\|<r\} within a fixed radius around its construction anchor and compute a local geometric embedding.
We adopt a pre-trained rotation-equivariant point-cloud encoder from BUFFER-X [ 28 ] with frozen weights, providing robustness to partial observations and sensor heterogeneity.
As a result, the representation remains compact while each node still carries both local 3D context and graph-level connectivity for cross-session correspondence and downstream navigation. Implementation details such as voxel downsampling are deferred to the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
关键几何设计选择是节点描述符如何定义.
与最初的每点配方不同,描述器锚定在可导航的图节点而不是云中现有的点.
对于每个节点 v i v_{i},我们收集点 { q ∈ P :‖ q − – p i ‖ < r } \{q\in\ mathcal{P}: \|q-\mathbf{p}_{i}\|<r\} \}在建构锚周围的固定半径内,并计算本地几何嵌入.
我们采用了来自BUFFER-X[28]的预先训练的旋转-等效点-云编码器,其重量为部分观测和传感器异质性提供了坚固性。
因此,代表仍然很紧凑,而每个节点仍然同时带有本地的3D上下文和用于跨会话通信和下游导航的图级连接. 毒液下取样等执行细节推迟到补充材料。

(b) Ground-truth node correspondences are established by pairwise Euclidean distances between node centers across sessions.
(c) Gaussian noise is injected into the edge weight to simulate odometry drift and construct training graph pairs.

图3:用于图表匹配的培训配对构建。 (a) 从两个部分重叠地覆盖同一场景的会话中抽取几何图。

blocks.en: 3.2 Correspondence Estimation
blocks.zh: 3.2 函证估计

blocks.en:
The FindCorr stage in Alg. 1 (lines 11 – 13 ) estimates cross-session correspondences.
Given topometric graphs constructed from different navigation sessions, our goal is to identify correspondences between nodes representing the same physical locations in the environment.
This problem requires reasoning over a noisy topometric graph, in which both the local geometry encoded in nodes and the graph structure are perturbed by measurement noise, odometry drift, and scene variation.
We treat the topometric graph as a shared representation, from which node correspondences are inferred as a signal used jointly for localization and navigation.
These correspondences are reused for both pose estimation and goal-directed navigation .
blocks.zh:
阿尔格1中的FindCorr阶段(第11行–13行)估计了跨会间通信.
鉴于通过不同导航会话构建的孔径图,我们的目标是确定代表环境中相同物理位置的节点之间的通信。
这个问题需要用一个吵闹的拓扑图来推理,在这个图中,节点中编码的局部几何和图表结构都受到测量噪声,偏振漂移和场景变化的干扰.
我们把孔径图当作一种共同的表示,从中推断出节点通信是共同用于本地化和导航的信号.
这些函证被重复使用,既用于姿势估计,也用于瞄准导航。

blocks.en:
Rather than relying on dense frame- or point-level matching, which can be disrupted by unobserved areas or local scene variations, our approach operates on sparse graphs.
Each node aggregates local 3D geometry over a traversable anchor using rotation-robust and view-invariant descriptors (Sec. 3.1 ), yielding a compact representation that naturally tolerates missing coverage under partial overlap and sensing heterogeneity.
In addition, the graph structure encodes spatial relationships among nodes, providing global context that helps disambiguate correspondences beyond local geometry.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法不是依赖密集的帧或点级比对,这种比对可能因未观测到的区域或局部场景变化而中断,而是以稀疏的图表运作。
每个节点利用旋转-阻力和视差变化描述符(Sec. 3.1)将可变锚上方的三维几何集合起来,形成一个紧凑的表示符,在部分重叠和感知异质的情况下自然能容忍缺失覆盖.
此外,图表结构还编码了节点之间的空间关系,提供了全球背景,有助于除局部几何外的函文分解.

blocks.en:
Matching Objective. Our objective is to predict a soft partial assignment between nodes in the reference and current graphs by jointly reasoning over node-level geometric features and graph connectivity.
We employ IPCA-GM [ 33 ] with Sinkhorn-normalized assignment to estimate correspondence probabilities while allowing unmatched nodes under partial overlap.
Because the prediction is constrained by both local geometry and graph structure, the resulting correspondences are more robust to local ambiguity, repeated structure, and incomplete coverage than geometry-only matching.
blocks.zh:
匹配目标。 我们的目标是通过对节点水平几何特征和图表连通性进行联合推理,预测参考图中节点和当前图中节点之间的软部分分配.
我们使用IPCA-GM [33] 与Sinkhorn的正常任务,来估计函证概率,同时允许在部分重叠的情况下出现无法匹配的节点.
由于预测同时受到局部几何和图结构的制约,因此所产生的函证比仅几何匹配更坚固到局部模糊,结构重复,覆盖不完整.

blocks.en:
Training Pair Construction. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , training pairs are constructed from two partial traversals collected in the same scene with different spatial coverage.
We build graphs 𝒢 A \mathcal{G}^{A} and 𝒢 B \mathcal{G}^{B} from these sessions and define correspondence supervision by spatial proximity between their construction anchors across sessions.
During training, we perturb traversable edge distances to improve robustness to odometry drift.
Exact objective and implementation details are deferred to the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
培训对等建设. 如图3所示,培训对是用在同一场景中收集的、具有不同空间覆盖的两条部分横道搭建的。
我们从这些会话中构建图形 G A \ mathcal{G}^{A} 和 G B \ mathcal{G}^{B}, 并用它们跨会话的建筑锚点之间的空间相近来定义通信监管 。
在训练期间,我们扰动了可移动的边缘距离,以提高稳健度,实现斜面漂移。
具体目标和执行细节推迟到补充材料。

blocks.en: 3.3 Localization and Waypoint Selection
blocks.zh: 3.3 定位和路标选择

blocks.en:
The NavScore stage in Alg. 1 (lines 16 – 23 ) reuses the predicted correspondences for both localization and waypoint selection.
Using the RANSAC-filtered node matches ℳ in \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{in}} , each matched node pair provides a position correspondence ( 𝐩 i ref , 𝐩 j cur ) (\mathbf{p}_{i}^{\text{ref}},\mathbf{p}_{j}^{\text{cur}}) .
We estimate the relative transformation T ref → cur ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 2 ) T_{\text{ref}\rightarrow\text{cur}}\in SE(2) from these inlier correspondences.
During deployment, odometry drift accumulates over time as the agent explores.
To reduce its impact on localization, we construct the current-session graph from a spatially local subset of recently observed traversable structure rather than from the full accumulated map.
blocks.zh:
阿尔格 1 (16 – 23行) 中的 NavScore 阶段重新使用预测的函式,用于本地化和路标选择.
使用 RANSAC- filtered 节点匹配 M 在\ mathcal{M}_{\ mathrm{in} 中, 每一个匹配的节点对提供了位置对应 (p i ref, p j cur) (\ mathbf{p}_{i}^{\ text{ref}},\mathbf{p}_{j}^{\ text{cur}}) .
我们估计相对的变换 T ref → cur → S E (2) T_{\text{ref}\rightarrow\text{ cur}}\in SE(2) 从这些更强烈的函文中得出.
在部署期间,随着物剂的探索,线粒体漂移会随时间而累积.
为了减少其对本地化的影响,我们用最近观测到的可变结构的空间局部子集,而不是用完整的累积图构建时段图。

blocks.en:
Our navigation policy directly reuses the topometric graph and cross-session correspondences introduced earlier, without additional representations or task-specific supervision.
Given the correspondence, we perform cross-session navigation by selecting nodes in the current graph as waypoints.
The policy balances exploitation of available goal information and exploration of unmapped areas using two complementary signals, a goal-directed score S goal S_{\text{goal}} derived from cross-session correspondences and a frontier-based exploration score S explore S_{\text{explore}} that promotes explored area expansion.
A goal g ∈ ℝ 2 g\in\mathbb{R}^{2} specified in the reference-session frame is converted into scores on the reference graph, and those scores are propagated to the current-session graph through the predicted correspondence. The exploration term is computed on the current occupancy map and evaluated at current-session graph nodes for waypoint selection.
Since the correspondence matches the holistic spatial context rather than individual nodes, reliable cross-session evidence becomes available only after sufficient exploration.
We therefore transition from using the exploration score only to the combined goal-directed and exploration score once cross-session evidence becomes reliable, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
The selected waypoint is then executed on the occupancy map using a Fast Marching Method planner [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh:

考虑到这些信件,我们通过选择当前图中的节点作为路标来进行跨会话导航.

参考会话框中指定的一个目标 g QQR 2 g\in\ mathbb{ R\2} 在参考图上转换成分数,这些分数通过预测的对应来传播到当前会话图中. 勘探期限根据目前的占用图计算,在本期地图节点进行评估,以选择出入口。

因此,如图2所示,一旦跨场证据变得可靠,我们就从只使用勘探分数过渡到目标定向和勘探综合分数。
然后在占用图上使用快速行进方法规划器执行选定的路标 [29].

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Table 1 : Evaluation protocol across datasets.
blocks.zh: 表1:各数据集的评价协议。

blocks.en:
We evaluate our approach on cross-session point-goal navigation experiments.
We assess navigation under odometry noise, varying scene scales, limited inter-session overlap, and scene change.
blocks.zh:
我们评价我们在跨会点目标导航实验方面的做法。
我们评估的是测量噪声下的导航、不同场景尺度、有限的会间重叠和场景变化。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on three datasets: Gibson [ 34 ] for the main evaluation under noiseless and noisy odometry, HM3D [ 22 ] for large-scale evaluation, and 3D-FRONT [ 9 ] for scene-change evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三个数据集进行评估:Gibson [34] 用于无噪声和吵闹的椭圆度测量法下的主要评价,HM3D [22]用于大规模评价,3D-FRONT [9]用于场景变化评价.

blocks.en: Experiments are conducted in Habitat [ 26 ] using the LoCoBot action space [ 16 ] . The agent takes discrete actions of moving forward by 0.25 m or turning left or right by 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} . The success threshold is 2.0 m for Gibson and HM3D. For 3D-FRONT, we use a 1.0 m threshold because the primary question is whether the representation remains locally reusable under scene change, rather than long-range planning. Table 1 summarizes the step budgets and scene scales used in each dataset. The graph matching network is trained on Gibson training scenes and is applied without retraining across all datasets. Unless otherwise noted, all methods are executed under the same simulator and action setting. Additional implementation details are deferred to the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 利用LoCoBot行动空间在生境进行实验[26]。 特工采取离散动作 前进0.25米 或左转或右转 10... 10... 成功阈值为2.0米的吉布森和HM3D. 对于3D-FRONT,我们使用一个1.0米的阈值,因为首要的问题是,在场景变化下,代表是否仍然可以在当地重复使用,而不是远程规划. 表1汇总了每个数据集采用的台阶预算和场景尺度。 图表匹配网络是在吉布森训练场景上训练的,并且在所有数据集中不经过再培训而应用. 除非另有说明,所有方法都在同一模拟和动作设定下执行. 其他执行细节推迟到补充材料。

blocks.en: In every episode, the goal is specified on the reference-session map, while the agent acts only in the current session. The reference and current sessions are collected at different times and from different start positions. The agent therefore cannot rely on frame-to-frame continuation across sessions and must recover a usable cross-session relation from partial overlap. This shared protocol lets us compare how well each representation supports map reuse rather than single-session exploration.
blocks.zh: 在每集中,目标都在参考片段映射中指定,而代理只在本期进行. 参考文献和当前会议在不同时间和不同起点位置收集。 因此,代理机构不能依赖跨会场的帧延续,必须从部分重叠中恢复可用的跨会场关系。 这一共同议定书让我们比较了每种表述如何支持地图的再利用,而不是单场探索。

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en: We compare against representative baselines spanning several reusable map abstractions. ANS [ 6 ] represents the environment with a dense occupancy-grid map. RnR-Map [ 15 ] uses a top-down visual feature map. AnyLoc [ 14 ] provides an appearance-based retrieval baseline using compact global descriptors. ConceptGraph [ 11 ] and ObjectReact [ 10 ] represent the environment with scene-graph or object-graph abstractions. We also compare against BUFFER-X [ 28 ] in the compactness analysis as a dense point-level geometric reference.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了具有代表性的基线,这些基线跨越了若干可重复使用的地图抽象。 ANS [6] 以密集的占用-网格地图代表环境. RnR-Map [15]使用自上而下的视觉特征图. AnyLoc [14]提供了使用紧凑的全球描述符的基于外观的检索基线. ConceptGraph [11] and ObjectReact [10] 以场景图或对象图抽象来代表环境. 我们还将BUFFER-X[28]在紧凑度分析中作为密集的点级几何参照物加以比较。

blocks.en: We prioritize baselines that expose an explicit reference-session representation and can be integrated into a goal-conditioned navigation loop in the current session. This lets us compare dense occupancy maps, top-down feature maps, appearance-based retrieval, and semantic graph abstractions under the same cross-session point-goal protocol. Several baselines were not originally proposed for this exact setting, so we adapt them while preserving their original representation and decision logic as much as possible. Full adaptation details are deferred to the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们确定基线的优先次序,这些基线暴露出明确的参考会议代表性,可纳入本届会议的有目标规定的导航圈。 这让我们可以比较密集的占用图,自上而下的特点图,基于外观的检索,以及在同一跨会点目标协议下的语义图抽象. 最初没有为这一确切设定提出若干基线,因此,我们尽可能地调整这些基线,同时保留其最初的代表性和决策逻辑。 完整的适应细节推迟到补充材料。

blocks.en: 4.3 Navigation Performance
blocks.zh: 4.3 导航性能

blocks.en:
Main evaluation on Gibson. Table 2 reports cross-session point-goal navigation under noiseless and noisy odometry.
We use Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) [ 1 ] . For ObjectReact, we report the result obtained with its original policy-coupled evaluation setting.
That method uses an RGB-frame-based controller [ 30 ] rather than the same discrete 0.25 m forward action used by the other methods here, so its SPL is informative but not strictly action-level comparable. Our method achieves the highest SR under both odometry conditions, and it also achieves the best SPL under noiseless odometry. Under noisy odometry, SR remains strong while SPL decreases more noticeably, suggesting that the representation still supports reliable cross-session recovery while path efficiency is more affected by delayed correspondence under drift.
blocks.zh:
吉布森的主要评价. 表2报告在无噪音和噪音偏振测量下跨会场点目标导航。
我们使用成功率和成功率按路径长度加权[1]。 对于ObjectReact,我们用其最初的政策相关评价设定来报告所获得的结果.
该方法使用基于RGB框架的控制器[30],而不是其他方法在此使用的相同的离散0.25米前方动作,因此其SPL信息丰富,但严格来说不具有行动层面的可比性. 我们的方法在两种偏振条件下都实现了最高的SR,在无噪声偏振条件下也实现了最好的SPL. 在吵闹的odometry下,SR保持强势,而SPL则更明显地减少,这表明该代表仍然支持可靠的跨会恢复,而路径效率则受到漂移下延迟通信的影响更大.

blocks.zh:
图5:定性跨会场导航结果. (a-b) HM3D和2D-3D-S环境中的导航实例。
(c-d) Gibson和3D-FRONT的场景变化中的例子,其中修改的区域用红框突出显示. 在整个这些设置中,拟议的拓扑图支持跨会场定位和瞄准方向导航,尽管部分重叠和局部环境变化.

blocks.en:
Large-scale evaluation on HM3D. Fig. 4 evaluates navigation as the difficulty of cross-session reuse increases.
For each episode, we first sample a reference-session start position and then choose the current-session start position to be a prescribed geodesic distance away.
We use this start-position separation as a controlled difficulty proxy. Larger separation generally makes useful overlap harder to recover early in the episode and therefore makes cross-session correspondence more difficult.
The figure reports accumulated successful episodes as this difficulty increases.
Our method degrades more gradually than the baselines and maintains the strongest performance in the harder regimes.
blocks.zh:
HM3D的大规模评价. 图4评价了随着跨会场复用难度增加的导航.
对于每集,我们首先取样一个参考-会话起始位置,然后选择当前会话起始位置作为规定的大地测量距离.
我们使用这种启动位置分离作为控制难度的代理. 更大规模的分离一般使有用的重叠更难于在剧集早期恢复,因此使跨会间通信更加困难.
这一数字报告,随着这种困难的增加,成功事例不断累积。
我们的方法比基线更逐步地退化,在较困难的制度中保持最强的性能。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Cross-session point-goal navigation results under scene changes on 3D-FRONT [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 表3:3D-FRONT上场景变化下的跨会场点-目标导航结果 [9].

blocks.en:
Evaluation under scene change. Table 3 reports results on 3D-FRONT with furniture additions, removals, rearrangements, and same-category replacements across sessions.
We use a 1.0 m success threshold in this setting because the goal is to test whether the representation remains locally reusable when object layout changes.
Our method achieves the highest SR and SPL in this setting.
This result suggests that the representation remains useful even when object arrangements differ across sessions. Fig. 5 shows a qualitative example.
The same figure also includes an additional qualitative example from 2D-3D-S [ 3 ] to illustrate behavior in a distinct large indoor environment with repetitive structure.
blocks.zh:
场景变化的评价。 表3显示3D-FRONT的家具添加、清除、重新安排和同类替换情况。
我们在此设置中使用一个1.0米成功阈值,因为目标是在对象布局变化时测试该表示是否仍然可以在当地重新使用.
我们的方法在这个环境中实现了最高的SR和SPL.
这一结果表明,即使各届届会的物体安排不同,代表性仍然有用。 图5显示了一个定性的例子。
同一数字还包括从2D-3D-S[3]中补充的定性例子,以说明在具有重复结构的截然不同的大室内环境中的行为.

blocks.en: 4.4 Compactness
blocks.zh: 4.4 紧凑性

blocks.en: Table 4 : Memory comparison across methods on Gibson [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 表4:吉布森上各种方法的内存比较 [34].

blocks.en:
Compactness. Table 4 compares the stored reference-session representation reused by each method in the current session.
Storage is measured on the representation retained after the reference-session traversal under the same episode data budget, rather than on transient intermediate states during construction.
For example, BUFFER-X stores the reference session as the voxel-downsampled point cloud used as input to matching.
The proposed representation is substantially smaller than dense occupancy grids, dense feature maps, and point-level geometry.
This follows from storing geometry only at sparse graph-node anchors and traversable connectivity, rather than across the full scene.
Detailed measurement protocol is provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
紧凑. 表4比较了本届会议中每种方法重新使用的存储参考会议代表。
存储量是根据参考会后在同一集数据预算下保留的表示量衡量的,而不是建筑期间的瞬间中间状态。
例如,BUFFER-X存储参考会话作为用于匹配的输入的Voxel-down采样点云.
提议的表示法大大小于密集占用网格、密集特征图和点级几何。
之所以如此,是因为只储存在稀少的图点锚和可互换的连接上,而不是在整个场景中。
补充材料中提供了详细的测量规程。

blocks.en: 4.5 Real-World Data Demonstration
blocks.zh: 4.5 真实世界数据演示

blocks.en: We further evaluate the representation on real-world cross-session data captured several weeks apart with heterogeneous sensors. One session uses a handheld LiDAR scanner and the other uses a mobile phone with built-in LiDAR. The two sessions are collected independently at different times of day. The LiDAR session was recorded in daytime, and the mobile-phone session was recorded at night. They cover only partially overlapping portions of the environment. The scene is an office building with repeated monitors, tables, and cubicles of similar design, which creates strong local ambiguity in both geometry and appearance across nearby locations. We use this example as a focused correspondence study rather than a closed-loop robot experiment. Acquisition and reconstruction details are deferred to the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估现实世界跨会话数据中与各种传感器相隔数周的情况。 一个会场使用手持LiDAR扫描仪,另一个会场使用内置LiDAR的手机. 这两个会议在不同的时间独立收集。 LiDAR会话白天录制,手机会话晚上录制. 它们只涵盖环境的部分重叠部分。 场景是一座办公楼,内有重复的显示器,桌子,以及类似设计的隔间,这在几何和相邻地点的外观上造成了强烈的局部模糊. 我们用这个例子作为重点通信研究,而不是闭路机器人实验. 采购和重建细节推迟到补充材料。

blocks.en: Fig. 1 illustrates the main conceptual value of the representation. The left side shows how the two sessions are related at the graph level through node correspondences. On the right, we select one query node and compare graph-structured matching against two weaker cues in isolation. The first is geometry-only matching based on node-descriptor similarity. The second is appearance-only matching based on DINOv2 features [ 19 ] . In this repeated office layout, both isolated cues yield multiple plausible candidates, while the graph-structured representation resolves the ambiguity and identifies the correct correspondence. We use this example as supporting evidence for the representation claim of the paper.
blocks.zh: 图1说明了代表性的主要概念价值。 左侧通过节点通信显示两个会话在图层之间的关联. 在右边,我们选择一个查询节点,并比较两个孤立的较弱提示的图结构匹配. 第一种是基于节点描述法相似性的仅几何匹配. 第二种是基于DINOv2特性的只显示匹配[19]. 在这种重复的办公室布局中,两个孤立的提示都产生多个可信的候选人,而图式的表述则解决了模糊性,并确定了正确的对应关系。 我们用这个例子作为证明文件陈述索赔的证据。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Scope
blocks.zh: 5 限制和范围

blocks.en:
This paper studies cross-session map reuse for single-floor indoor navigation under a 2D top-down point-goal formulation. Multi-floor environments and explicit vertical connectivity are outside the current evaluation scope, and extending the representation to such settings is a natural direction for future work.
Within that scope, we focus on cross-session reuse under partial overlap, sensing variation, and moderate scene change. More severe changes to traversable connectivity, such as closed doors, blocked corridors, or large structural reconfiguration, were not systematically evaluated here and remain an important area for future study.
Finally, the real-world evaluation in this paper is a demonstration on independently captured data rather than a full onboard deployment with live control, sensing, and recovery behaviors. This is still useful for validating the representation, but it also sets a clear boundary on what the current experiments prove.
blocks.zh:
本文研究了在2D自上而下点目标设计下单层室内导航的跨场图再利用。 多层环境和明确的纵向连通性超出了目前的评价范围,将代表性扩大到这种环境是今后工作的自然方向。
在这个范围内,我们侧重于在部分重叠、感知变化和中度场景变化的情况下进行跨会场再利用。 这里没有系统地评估对可互联互通的更严重改变,例如关闭大门、封锁走廊或大规模结构重组,这仍然是今后研究的一个重要领域。
最后,本文中的现实世界评价是对独立获取的数据的演示,而不是以活控制,感知,和恢复行为进行全机部署. 这对于验证表示仍然有用,但也为当前实验所证明的事物确定了明确的界限.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present a sparse topometric graph representation that serves as an effective abstraction for cross-session indoor localization and goal-directed navigation.
Experiments show reliable performance under odometry noise, limited overlap, large-scale scenes, and environmental changes, underscoring the practicality of the representation for cross-session map reuse.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个稀疏的图示,作为跨会场室内定位和瞄准导航的有效抽象。
实验显示在odometry噪声,有限重叠,大面积场景,以及环境变化下有可靠的性能,突出了跨会场地图再利用的表示实用性.
